ideas.title: Hammer for Meteors
ideas.hook: A meteor shower hits the map every few minutes. Race to the craters and smash the glowing rocks open before other players do; each one hides a space egg.
core_loop: Wait for the storm siren and watch where meteors land
Run to a crater and hammer the meteor until it cracks
Hatch the space egg inside for a pet that boosts hammer power
Upgrade hammers to crack bigger, rarer meteors in new zones
ideas.twist: Meteor size scales with the storm level, and a server-wide Mega Meteor needs everyone hitting it at once to break.
monetization: VIP storm alerts and crater teleports
Luck pass for rare space eggs
retention: Space egg index with secret rarities
Offline crater earnings from your pets
ideas.why_now: Break × Disaster/weather is an open gap (score 6.08). Break/mine is the fastest mechanic at 3.25× (Break and Steal an Egg 162K CCU at 37 days, Drill for Eggs 13.8K at 26 days) and disaster/weather is rising 1.21× ([🌋] Swim For Eggs! 9.7K). The "___ for ___" title formula leads at 3.73×.
ideas.differentiator: Mining games have static rocks; here the loot falls from the sky on a timer, so players rush and compete for each drop.

ideas.title: Shuffle for Cars
ideas.hook: Open card packs of car parts (engine, wheels, body, paint), snap your best hand into a car, and test it on your drag strip.
core_loop: Open a pack of part cards with cash
Slot five cards into a car blueprint
Run the car on your plot's drag strip for cash based on top speed
Buy better packs and garage upgrades
ideas.twist: Matching set cards (all parts from one brand) trigger a combo bonus that doubles a stat, so players chase full sets.
monetization: Speed pass for faster pack opening
Luck pass for rare part cards
ideas.why_now: Dice/cards × Vehicles is an open gap (6.63). Dice/cards is the second-fastest mechanic at 2.42× (Anime Dice 59.2K CCU at 58 days, Pack A Rare Card 2.0K) and tycoon/base building is at 2.07×. Vehicles is rising 1.11× with Steal A Car at 7.5K.
ideas.differentiator: Card games are anime fights; this turns the pull into a car you build and race, so every card has a visible effect.

ideas.title: Mine for Mechs
ideas.hook: Mech parts are buried in ore veins. Dig them out, collect every arm, leg and core, and assemble a giant mech that digs ten times faster.
core_loop: Mine ore walls with a drill
Find buried mech parts with rarity tiers
Assemble parts into a mech on your base
Pilot the mech to break bigger ore veins in deeper zones
ideas.twist: Your mech can be sent out alone to mine while you are offline, and its parts decide what it brings back.
ideas.why_now: Break × Robots/mechs is an open gap (5.64). Break/mine leads at 3.25× and stones/rocks is the fastest theme at 2.7× (+1 Stone Skipping 33.8K, Lift Rock For Eggs 17.4K at 15 days). Collect/index is at 2.21×.
ideas.differentiator: The thing you dig up is also the tool that digs, so every find makes the next dig faster.

ideas.title: +1 Drum Power
ideas.hook: Every drum hit gives +1 power. Hit hard enough and the sound wave shatters walls, cars and finally buildings.
core_loop: Hit the drum to gain +1 power
Blast a sound wave at the next object
Earn cash from what breaks
Buy bigger drums and new stages
ideas.twist: Hitting on the beat gives +3 instead of +1, so rhythm skill speeds you up.
monetization: Luck pass for rare drum skins
ideas.why_now: Music/dance is rising 1.77× (Piano Rhythm Tiles 7.2K at 25 days, Aura Dance Battles 7.0K) and the "+1 ___" formula is at 1.66× (+1 Stone Skipping 33.8K, +1 Assassin Leveling 9.2K at 18 days). Hit/swing is at 1.55×.
ideas.differentiator: A +1 game where timing matters: on-beat hits are worth triple, so it plays like a light rhythm game.

ideas.title: Frost vs Lava
ideas.hook: Lava creeps toward your base every round. Paint ice over it to freeze it into walls, then build on the cooled rock.
core_loop: Lava flows out of a volcano each wave
Paint frost paths to freeze and block it
Mine the cooled rock for cash
Upgrade brushes and base defenses
ideas.twist: Frozen lava turns into building blocks, so the better you defend, the more you can build.
ideas.why_now: Paint × Ice/fire is an open gap (5.69). Ice/fire/elements is rising 1.85× (Firefighting Sim 🚒 14.6K at 20 days, Kaiju Alpha 8.9K) and paint/create is at 1.99× (Paint to Get Rich 24.5K). The "___ vs ___" formula is at 1.14× (Bunker vs Verity 18.3K).
ideas.differentiator: Painting is the defense: what you draw becomes the wall that saves your base.

ideas.title: Trap for Zombies
ideas.hook: Zombies roam the lab halls. Set traps, catch rare zombies and fill your containment wing; rare zombies earn more cash.
core_loop: Explore lab corridors and set traps
Catch zombies of different rarities
Put them in pens on your lab floor for cash
Unlock deeper lab wings with rarer zombies
ideas.twist: Mutation events make two caught zombies merge into a new variant you can't find in the halls.
ideas.why_now: Collect × Zombies is an open gap (4.72). Collect/index is at 2.21× (Lift Rock For Eggs 17.4K at 15 days, Steal ASMR! 12.0K), zombies is rising 1.31× (Build and Kill Zombies 13.7K) and interior maps are the fastest map style at 1.87×.
ideas.differentiator: Zombie games make you fight them; this one makes you catch and collect them like pets.

ideas.title: Brush for Fossils
ideas.hook: Dig and brush fossils out of rock. Each fossil becomes a dino card, and you battle your deck against other players.
core_loop: Dig through rock layers
Brush the fossil clean for a quality grade
The fossil turns into a dino card
Battle decks for cash and new dig sites
ideas.twist: Cleaner brushing gives better card stats, so careful digging beats spamming clicks.
ideas.why_now: Dice/cards × Dinosaurs is an open gap (4.19). Break/mine is at 3.25× (Dig For Eggs 11.0K at 39 days), dice/cards at 2.42× (Anime Dice 59.2K) and stones/rocks at 2.7×.
ideas.differentiator: Card pulls come from digging instead of packs, and how carefully you dig decides card quality.

ideas.title: +1 Heel Height
ideas.hook: Every step makes your heels +1 taller. Walk over walls, rivers and buildings that shorter players can't pass.
core_loop: Walk to grow your heels
Step over obstacles on the course
Reach new stages for cash
Buy heel styles that grow faster
ideas.twist: If you trip on the course you lose half your height, so balance matters as you get tall.
monetization: Luck pass for rare heel styles
ideas.why_now: +1 × Fashion/beauty is an open gap (3.93). Fashion/beauty is rising 1.62× (Makeup Mania! 27.5K at 17 days) and the "+1 ___" formula is at 1.66× (+1 Wings For Eggs 10.4K, +1 Assassin Leveling 9.2K).
ideas.differentiator: Fashion games are dress-up; here the outfit is the stat, and it's a silly meme visual.

ideas.title: Sell Geodes
ideas.hook: Crack geodes open behind your shop counter and sell the crystals. Rare crystals sell for a fortune, but customers can also buy uncracked ones as a gamble.
core_loop: Dig geodes from the quarry
Choose to crack or sell sealed
Sell crystals to customers
Upgrade the shop and tools
ideas.twist: Sealed geodes sell to customers who sometimes come back angry or thrilled, changing your shop rating.
ideas.why_now: Stones/rocks is the fastest theme at 2.7× (+1 Stone Skipping 33.8K, Lift Rock For Eggs 17.4K) and sell/shop is rising 1.36× (Sell Fries! 29.8K at 21 days). Break/mine is at 3.25×.
ideas.differentiator: A shop game with a gamble: crack it yourself or sell it sealed.

ideas.title: Fire vs Ice Cards
ideas.hook: Pick fire or ice, roll for elemental cards and battle the other side in 1v1 arena duels. The winning team each hour gets a server-wide boost.
core_loop: Roll for elemental cards
Build a 6-card deck
Duel the other team in the arena
Earn shards to roll again
ideas.twist: Team war: every duel win adds to your side's meter, and the winning side gets a 2x luck hour.
ideas.why_now: Dice/cards × Ice/fire is the second-best open gap (6.92). Dice/cards is at 2.42× (Anime Dice 59.2K at 58 days), ice/fire at 1.85×, and the Dice + RNG pair already holds 59.2K young CCU. Arena maps are rising 1.35×.
ideas.differentiator: Card battlers are solo; here every duel feeds a team war with a server reward.
